name: Thorn Hill
summary: At Thorn Hill, Razormane warbands strike Horde supply lines east of the Crossroads. Their fortified camp holds the high ridges between Durotar and the Barrens interior.

sections.title: A Thorn in the Horde's Side
sections.body: Thorn Hill commands the roads between Durotar and the Crossroads. Razormane hunters gather here with trained wolves and geomancers who shape the earth. Elder Mystic Razorsnout guides the quilboar, and their attacks on Horde supply caravans grow bolder. So the camp, close to vital routes, is one of the Crossroads guards' most immediate threats in the central savanna.

faq.answer: Thorn Hill is a Razormane camp on the northern Barrens ridges between the Crossroads and Durotar.

faq.q: Who leads the quilboar at Thorn Hill?
faq.answer: Elder Mystic Razorsnout guides the Razormane warbands at Thorn Hill.

faq.q: Why is the Horde fighting the quilboar here?
faq.answer: Razormane warbands ambush Horde supply caravans traveling from Durotar to the Crossroads. Horde authorities send warriors to clear the ridges.

faq.q: What kinds of enemies live in Thorn Hill?
faq.answer: Razormane geomancers, hunters, trained wolves, and berserkers defend the camp.

angles.text: As a Horde warrior, you can help secure the road between the Crossroads and Durotar by facing the raiders at Thorn Hill.
